title: rcplug plugin manifest
description: plugin.json in a plugin directory. See docs/plugin-api.md.

name.description: Informational. The plugin id is always the directory name.

description.description: One or two sentences for the plugin list (English).

exec.description: Command line, run in the plugin directory. Start the plugin's own program with ./ (a bare name is looked up in PATH). {{port}} becomes the assigned loopback port, {{dir}} the plugin directory.

httpProxy.description: Loopback address the host proxies /plugins/<name>/ to, usually 127.0.0.1:{{port}}. Omit for plugins without a web UI.

needsAudio.description: Advisory badge in the dashboard (older form of the permission "audio").

permissions.description: What the plugin does beyond its own pages, shown on its card in the dashboard. desk:write: changes the desk through the console (the console refuses writes from plugins without it). audio: hears the desk through the shared audio taps (the host refuses the stream without it). network and device: shown only. See docs/plugin-api.md#permissions.

primary.description: Open this plugin as the dashboard's start page.

icon.description: Short glyph or emoji for the navigation.

update.description: Where updates of this plugin come from: the latest GitHub release of this repository, with a signed release.json (see docs/updates.md). Updates are only offered and installed from the dashboard.

publicKey.description: Ed25519 public key (base64) that signs this plugin's releases, trusted in addition to rcplug's built-in release keys. The key in the installed plugin.json checks the next update.

translations.description: Localised title and description keyed by language code.

options.description: Localised option titles, descriptions and choice titles, keyed by option id.

actions.description: Entry points other UIs show for this plugin, e.g. a button on every channel strip of the console. Needs httpProxy.

context.description: Where the action is shown. The console knows "channel".

path.description: Relative to the plugin's UI. Placeholders for "channel": {strip}, {index}, {source}, {label}.

options.description: Settings users change in the dashboard (Plugins → Settings), so no one needs a shell. The host passes a value a user has set as a command-line argument (arg) or an environment variable (env); otherwise the plugin's own default applies. Values are kept in config/<name>.json. See docs/plugin-api.md#options.

default.description: The plugin's own default, shown in the dashboard; it is not passed.

pattern.description: Text: a regular expression the whole value must match.

arg.description: bool: the flag added when true (--read-only); otherwise one argument with {value} (--level={value}).

env.description: An environment variable set to the value (bool: 1 or 0); not RCPLUG_*.
